slides.headline: Reddit isn't a review site. That's what makes it harder.
No business profile.
slides.body: There's nowhere official for you to respond.

slides.headline: No star rating to recover.
slides.body: One thread can define you on its own.

slides.headline: Anonymous accounts.
slides.body: Anyone can post, and anyone can pile on.

slides.headline: Every community has its own moderators and rules.
A brand account replying usually makes it worse.
slides.body: Reddit is not kind to companies defending themselves.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
